response.original_title: The Woman Who Woke Up Chinese
response.overview: In 2010, 38-year-old Sarah Colwill's life was changed forever. She was rushed to hospital suffering from what she thought was a severe migraine, but when she woke up her local Plymouth accent had disappeared, leaving her sounding Chinese.
response.tagline: In 2010, 38-year-old Sarah Colwill's life was changed forever.
response.title: The Woman Who Woke Up Chinese
